intended_object: This is the initial state of the outer loop in a polynomial-time, bit-string-encoded greedy row-matching procedure. It packs the reversed row candidates, an empty list of selected pairs, and the source input into one encoded tuple. I inferred this from the docstring and the surrounding definitions in MachineGreedyRowMatching.lean.
explanation: The body is `pair (machineMatchingReverseRange optimizer) (pair [] optimizer)`. It encodes the starting state of a loop so that the library can prove the overall procedure lies in FP (polynomial-time computable functions). This is an implementation detail of an algorithm's state encoding, not a standard mathematical notion. It does match its docstring: reverse-ordered row candidates and no selected pairs.
